subject: door
name: 门
label: 圆顶小门
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One arched door front view with a single knob and broad frame.
Draw only this architectural component, no surrounding wall or building. Clean hand-drawn outlines and generous empty white interiors. No brick, woodgrain, hatch marks, glass shine strokes, gray wash, shadow, tiny repeating shutters slats or extra decorative objects. Fully visible, centered with 12 percent clear margins.
